title: The Ashlands
premise: An industrial civilization exhausted its lands; wind and deep water are reclaiming the ruins.
playerRole: A wandering surveyor rebuilding an understanding of the broken landscape.
worldRules: Terrain and ecology tell the same story of erosion and recovery.
Ancient industrial remnants remain rare landmarks rather than uniform decoration.
mainConflict: Discover whether a living homeland can emerge from the exhausted world.

beats.title: Read the land
beats.description: Cross the landforms and locate the drowned depths before deciding where recovery begins.
